text: Delays and cancellations happen. On a board, fällt aus means the train is cancelled, and +10 means ten minutes late. In Germany passengers whose train is more than an hour late can usually claim a part of the fare back. A conductor or an information desk will tell you your options.
If you miss a connection because of a delay, ask a member of staff, and say Ich habe meinen Anschluss verpasst. ("I have missed my connection.")
